answer_1.quote: Multi-document Summarization (MDS) consists of creating a short and concise summary that includes the salient information in a set of related documents.
answer_1.outputs: summaries that combine information from multiple source documents

answer_2.quote: When evaluating a new summarization model, beyond lexical similarity between the system and reference summary (ie. ROUGE), it is common to also report specific aspects such as relevance and informativeness , faithfulness , grammar, redundancy , or sentence fusion .
